title: Great Fire of London: How One Mayor's Hesitation Burned a City

Great Fire of London 1666: The Indecision That Caused Disaster
How the Great Fire of London Was Started by a Mayor's Delay
description:
Discover how the Great Fire of London in 1666 grew from a small bakery spark into a historic urban disaster.

Learn how Lord Mayor Sir Thomas Bloodworth's fatal hesitation stopped early firebreaks, and how King Charles II finally halted the flames using gunpowder, reshaping modern London forever.
